sentences.text: VERSUS  STATE OF UTTAR PRADESH & ANR. Respondent(s)
Date : 03-09-2025 This petition was called on for hearing today.
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE J.B. PARDIWALA  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP MEHTA

For Petitioner(s) :
 Mr. Nikhil Sharma, Adv.
 Mr. Prabhat Ranjan Raj, AOR  Mr. Anil Kumar, Adv.
 For Respondent(s) :
 Mr. Ankit Goel, AOR  Mr. Bharat Singh, Adv.
 Mr. Mayank Tiwari, Adv.
 Mr. Abhi Garg, Adv.
 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R 1.

The petitioner has been denied bail by the High Court in connection with Case Crime No.381/2023 registered with Police Station  Naubasta, District Kanpur Nagar, Uttar Pradesh for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366 and 376 of the Indian Penal Code respectively and Sections 3 and 4 of the Protection of 14:44:37

IST Reason:
Children from Sexual Offences Act. 2012 respectively.

sentences.text:
We take notice of the fact that the petitioner  herein came to be arrested on 17-7-2023 and since then he is in judicial custody.
3. We are conscious of the fact that the trial is in progress.
We are also conscious of the fact that the victim has already stepped into the witness box and her oral evidence is over.
4. Considering the age of the accused and the victim and also having regard to the facts and circumstances of this case, we are persuaded to exercise our discretion in favor of the petitioner.
5. The petitioner is ordered to be released on bail subject to terms and conditions that the Trial Court may deem fit to impose.
7. With the aforesaid, the Special Leave Petition is disposed of.
8. Pending applications, if any, also stand disposed of.

(VISHAL ANAND) (NIDHI WASON)
ASTT. REGISTRAR-cum-PS COURT MASTER (NSH)
